body: U+0023# Meadow recolour stutter (PR #247): pacer amendments, 2026-09-30U+000AU+000AU+002D The first amendment (8 ms processor budget plus a shared recolour allowance, branch mitosis/meadow-recolour-amend 6e37ae7, not pushed) made the emulator worse: opening frames went to 123-180 ms against 61-104 ms. Traces on the emulator and on the Note10+ showed 84-90 plant bakes queued in one frame.U+000AU+002D The owner rejected any per-frame limit tuned on one phone. Recorded as decision 01M3TN7Y2TF9WBNP1S8QFQ17MJ and as the memory device-adaptive-performance.U+000AU+002D A probe on the Note10+, the lab emulator and the lab Mac VM confirmed the replacement approach: GPU markers sent before and after each batch answer in queue order. Best phone variant: longest frames 47-76 ms in 11 of 12 cases, scene ready 657-858 ms.U+000AU+002D Spec docs/specs/meadow-opening-recolour-stutter.md was amended and approved twice:U+000A  U+002D Step meadow-pacer: one app-wide pacer. Batches are sized from each device's measured cost per kind of step. The GPU share is one frame interval while loading and half a frame once open. Processor work is capped at half the frame interval.U+000A  U+002D Step pacer-fixes: the review fixes. Creation steps teach no cost, a covered Meadow's turn claims the next frame, and the valve still learns from late answers.U+000AU+002D The owner also decided:U+000A  U+002D Scene-ready time on older devices is reported, not bounded.U+000A  U+002D The lab Mac VM is the capable-device check; the bench is not run natively on the owner's Mac.U+000A  U+002D Lowering visual quality is out of scope unless the owner asks.U+000AU+002D meadow-pacer was built by mitosis as branch mitosis/meadow-recolour-pacer (82c7f77), not pushed. Gate 12/12 pass; full suite green.U+000A  U+002D Emulator, Mac idle: page and study longest frames 44-61 ms in 7 of 8 cases (148 ms in the first case); scene ready 498-591 ms.U+000A  U+002D The code review found the creation-step flaw, which pacer-fixes now addresses.U+000AU+002D pacer-fixes was dispatched as run ~/.mitosis/runs/field-notes/2026-09-30-recolour-fixes, branch mitosis/meadow-recolour-fixes, built from mitosis/meadow-recolour-pacer with --no-push.U+000AU+002D Test kit scripts now live in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/testkit/bin (phone_bench, emu_bench, mac_bench, build_bench, suite, s1017.py), because the session scratchpad was wiped by a reboot.
